eventMetadata.context_description: Alphabet currently trades as the clear third-largest company by market capitalization, sitting behind NVIDIA and ahead of Apple amid ongoing AI-driven gains in search, cloud, and large language model capabilities. With the resolution date only days away, traders see little room for Apple, Microsoft, or other contenders to overtake it through normal volatility, as recent share-price movements have kept the ordering stable. The market-implied odds reflect this near-term inertia rather than any long-term forecast, though an unexpected earnings surprise, regulatory ruling, or broad tech-sector rotation could still shift relative valuations before month-end.
